_source.table: Table 16.1 - Interim relaxation period for each implementation phase
_source.extraction: pdfplumber extract_tables() on p121 returns this table cleanly (4 data rows; the 'Period' header wraps onto its own row); the JSON below was hand-transcribed and then cross-checked cell-by-cell against that extraction - they agree exactly
_source.verify: docker exec <db> psql -U myinvois -d myinvois -c "SELECT content FROM chunks WHERE doc='specific_guideline' AND section='16.1'"

_warning: The lead sentence of s16.1 says 'six (6)-month interim relaxation period ... of each implementation phase'. That is true for phases 1-3 ONLY. Table 16.1 row 4 grants phase 4 until 31 December 2027 - up to 24 months. Reading the prose and ignoring the table is exactly the error the Day 2 chain made on Q7.

phases.note: Table 16.1 row 4 lists both the 1 January 2026 and the 1 July 2026 implementation dates under the same end date of 31 December 2027.
